description: 🦀 Decoder-only LLM built from scratch in pure Rust using Candle — no Python, no PyTorch. Gated DeltaNet + sparse attention, fine-grained MoE, native video/document understanding, long-horizon tool agents, quantization-aware training. Scales: Tiny (25M) to Large (1.3B).
